record.question: The Control Unit performs which one of the following functions?
options: Directs the operation of the CPU and coordinates activities
Converts digital data to analog signals
record.explanation: The control unit directs processor operations and coordinates activity among the CPU components. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026.
